text: {"summary": "Cluster 'edge' has 2 CRITICAL and 1 HIGH image vulnerabilities: two in k3s-managed kube-system add-ons (traefik, metrics-server) and one in monitoring/grafana with no fix available. Kubescape reports NSA 80.0 and MITRE 85.0, with one failed control listed (C-0017, LOW). The only admin binding is cluster-admin to Group:/system:masters, which looks like a platform default. Node and control-plane CIS checks were not run.", "targets": ["edge"], "frameworks": [{"name": "NSA", "passed": 15, "failed": 5, "skipped": 6, "score": 80}, {"name": "MITRE", "passed": 13, "failed": 3, "skipped": 6, "score": 85}], "findings": [{"severity": "CRITICAL", "title": "Traefik image has critical CVE (k3s add-on)", "resource": "kube-system/Deployment/traefik", "controls": ["CVE-2026-65600"], "evidence": "CVE-2026-65600 in github.com/traefik/traefik/v3 installed v3.6.13, fixed 3.6.23 (CRITICAL); this is a k3s-managed add-on, but it is likely the ingress entry point.", "fix": "Upgrade traefik to 3.6.23 or later (for k3s, upgrade k3s or set the image tag via a HelmChartConfig).", "confidence": "high"}, {"severity": "CRITICAL", "title": "metrics-server grpc critical CVE (k3s add-on)", "resource": "kube-system/Deployment/metrics-server", "controls": ["CVE-2026-33186"], "evidence": "CVE-2026-33186 in google.golang.org/grpc installed v1.72.0, fixed 1.79.3 (CRITICAL).", "fix": "Upgrade metrics-server to a build with grpc 1.79.3 or later (for k3s, upgrade k3s).", "confidence": "high"}, {"severity": "HIGH", "title": "Grafana library vulnerability with no fix available", "resource": "monitoring/Deployment/grafana", "controls": ["CVE-2026-11111"], "evidence": "CVE-2026-11111 in libxyz installed 2.1, fixed none (HIGH).", "fix": "No fixed version is known. Look for a newer Grafana image without libxyz, limit network exposure of Grafana, and track the advisory.", "confidence": "high"}, {"severity": "LOW", "title": "cluster-admin bound to system:masters (likely platform default)", "resource": "cluster-admin", "controls": [], "evidence": "Binding cluster-admin has role cluster-admin and subject Group:/system:masters.", "fix": "No change needed if default. Verify no extra subjects: kubectl get clusterrolebinding cluster-admin -o yaml", "confidence": "medium"}, {"severity": "LOW", "title": "Immutable container filesystem not enforced", "resource": "edge/Deployment/gw", "controls": ["C-0017"], "evidence": "C-0017 Immutable container filesystem failed on 3 resources, example edge/Deployment/gw.", "fix": "securityContext:\n  readOnlyRootFilesystem: true", "confidence": "high"}, {"severity": "LOW", "title": "Medium image vulnerabilities and low misconfigurations", "resource": "edge cluster (trivy k8s)", "controls": [], "evidence": "vuln_counts MEDIUM: 20 and misconfig_counts LOW: 3; details are not in the digest.", "fix": "Review with: trivy k8s --severity MEDIUM,LOW and rebuild images on updated bases.", "confidence": "low"}], "not_checked": [{"item": "node and control-plane CIS checks", "reason": "need a privileged node-collector pod; the audit identity is read-only"}, {"item": "git history", "reason": "secrets removed from history are not scanned"}, {"item": "Kubescape failed controls beyond C-0017", "reason": "NSA shows 5 failed and MITRE 3 failed, but the digest lists only one failed control"}]}
